title: Skeleton Knight in Another World
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A gamer wakes as his online avatar Arc, a powerful knight who is a skeleton under his armor. He keeps his helmet on, works as a mercenary, and teams up with the elf warrior Ariane and the beast-girl ninja Chiyome to free elves and beast people from a slave trade backed by corrupt human nobles and an empire.
life_message: Real strength should be used to free the captive and protect the weak, whatever you look like underneath.

content.note: Arc kills bandits and slavers; raids on slave warehouses (Wikipedia); critics noted violent scenarios (Wikipedia, ANN).
